falsifiable_hypothesis: Targetwise cross-fitted gain contains useful calibration signal but is unstable because only three inner patient folds are available. Jackknife-SNR shrinkage toward the existing patient-weighted target-union gain controls variance, while equal hedging with the bounded raw gain restores half of the signal discarded by shrinkage without opening a tunable hedge menu.
gain_rule: For each outer partition use the authenticated three inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF tensors at the already-selected spectral option. Compute patient-count-weighted amplitude theta and stable prior gain g0_j=1+c_union*s_j exactly as in patient_weighted_target_union_confidence_js. Rebuild theta_-k on the other two folds, compute bounded raw gain graw_j=clip(-2 sum n_k theta_-k,j rB_k,j / sum n_k theta_-k,j^2,1,3). Recompute the same bounded estimator leaving out each held pair to obtain standard K=3 jackknife variance v_j. With delta_j=graw_j-g0_j define reliability a_j=delta_j^2/(delta_j^2+v_j), stabilized gain gst_j=g0_j+a_j delta_j, then final gain g_j=0.5*gst_j+0.5*graw_j. Apply qA=qA_loo_bagged and qB=qB_interpolated_jackknife-0.5*g_j*theta_j.
hedge_rule: The raw/stabilized gain weights are exactly 0.5/0.5 by symmetry before canonical replay. There is no per-fold or per-target hedge weight, no outer-held outcome routing, and no A/B prediction averaging.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
